verdict.rationale: v0 docs explicitly advertise one-click deploy to production via Vercel infrastructure (v0-docs-8, v0-docs-32), with production URLs tied to Projects and updated on deploy (v0-docs-29, v0-docs-46), and community evidence corroborates rapid deployment of working apps (v0-comm-1). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of the one-click publish flow (not just general app-building speed) and no evidence addressing custom domain setup friction.
